explicit_validation.explanation: The paper explicitly validates LLM judgments against human evaluation by comparing their labels on a subset of 100 examples from the TrueTeacher dataset, reporting quantitative accuracy metrics.

prompts.notes: Exact prompts provided in Appendix A.1 and A.2, including zero-shot and chain-of-thought variants with examples

human_eval_details.num_evaluators: Multiple NLP researchers (exact number not specified)

guidelines.notes: Detailed human evaluation guidelines provided in Appendix A.8 based on Rashkin et al.'s attribution definition with explicit instructions

sample_size.notes: Human evaluation conducted on 100 examples sampled from the full 1.4M dataset generated by TrueTeacher

quantitative_scores.notes: Overall labeling accuracy of sampled TrueTeacher examples

validation_results.summary_finding: FLAN-PaLM 540B achieves 89% accuracy on factual consistency evaluation compared to human judgments, demonstrating reliable performance as a data labeling tool.

criteria_mapping.notes: Both LLM and human evaluation assessed factual consistency using the same attribution-based criteria
